moat_against: No structural pricing power — fee compression from passive and larger rivals (BlackRock, Vanguard, State Street); clients re-bid mandates competitively
Measured returns collapsed — roic_proxy 16.11% (FY2021) to 2.77% (FY2024) and 3.88% (FY2025); operating margin 22.25% to 6.89% over the same span
Western Asset overhang — over $140B of FY2025 outflows after the Ken Leech cherry-picking investigation, a $100M SEC settlement charge in Q3 FY26, and still $1.1B of outflows in that quarter
Market-geared earnings — AUM and fees move with markets ($98.0B of Q3 FY26 AUM growth was net market change vs $18.4B of inflows), and OE/share CAGR over 2 years is -6.60% in dcf_numbers.json
moat_for: Scale and global distribution — $1,791.6B AUM at June 30, 2026, record AUM, positive long-term net inflows of $18.4B in Q3 FY26 across every asset class and geography
Diversified platform — alternatives AUM ~$294B, ETFs $75.6B, retail SMAs and Canvas, plus specialist boutiques, so no single product carries the firm

Sticky client base and brand — long institutional/wealth relationships, $500B+ of AUM outside the US per the company's positioning, and a sustained capital return (DPS TTM $1.31, dividends paid TTM $693,900,000 and buybacks TTM $511,900,000 in fundamentals.json)
moat_justification: Large diversified manager ($1,791.6B AUM at June 30, 2026, global distribution, $294B+ alternatives, growing ETF/Canvas platforms) with scale and sticky institutional/wealth relationships, but no durable pricing power: fees compress toward passive/alternatives competitors, traditional active products face secular outflow pressure, and Western Asset lost over $140B in FY2025 after the Ken Leech investigation. Measured history caps the score: roic_proxy fell from 16.11% (FY2021) and 13.58% (FY2022) to 8.00% (FY2023), 2.77% (FY2024) and 3.88% (FY2025) in fundamentals.json — below cost of capital for two years — and operating margin fell from 22.25% (FY2021) to 6.89% (FY2025). A 4 gives CAP 7.2 years.
name: Franklin Resources, Inc. (Franklin Templeton)
one_liner: Diversified global asset manager in a flow recovery, moat 4/10 — does not clear 15% on the standardized OE base (weighted IRR 6.83%, IV@15% $10.72 vs $30.96 price); it clears 15% only at ~$10.72, and even the super-bull case yields only 10.98%.
